items.name: tilted-card
items.title: Tilted Card
items.description: 3D tilt-on-mouse card with spring physics and a cursor-following caption.

items.name: bell-toggle
items.title: Bell Toggle
items.description: Pill toggle that answers a press at three tempos: the bell rings on damped keyframes, the label blur-crossfades, and the pill unfurls to the longer label through a clip-path on a critically damped spring. The pressed state is the receipt.

items.name: branched-menu
items.title: Branched Menu
items.description: Collapsible menu whose sections unfold into a trunk with a curved branch to each child, and an accent line that travels down the trunk and around the curve to whatever you pick, while a marker glides to the open section.

items.name: call-chip
items.title: Call Chip
items.description: Inline tool-call chip whose fill wipes across while a live ms counter ticks, completing with a green wash on success or stopping short and shaking red with a retry glyph on error.

items.name: code-slots
items.title: Code Slots
items.description: One-time-code input where a hidden overlay input owns focus, paste and SMS autofill while each slot lands its digit on one spring: the fill swells from the centre, the digit rises and the caret glides; a wrong code drains the slots in a cascade, a right one merges them into a single accent wash.

items.name: comet-dial
items.title: Comet Dial
items.description: Tick-ring dial you flick by angle: the reading launches on a spring and a velocity-driven comet streaks behind the lit head, trailing the direction of travel and vanishing at rest.

items.name: dodge-field
items.title: Dodge Field
items.description: Wrapper that makes any child flee the pointer inside a bounded field, dodges once per approach, then relents after a few tries and glides home.

items.name: flip-card
items.title: Flip Card
items.description: Two-faced card that flips in 3D on a click, a drag or a flick, settling on a spring that carries your release velocity, with an optional cursor tilt, a sheen that follows the pointer and a shadow that narrows as it turns edge on.

items.name: folder-float
items.title: Folder Float
items.description: Folder that opens on hover or press: the flap tilts toward you, a paper edge rises, and its notes spring out from behind the flap into a floating cloud to pick from, then sink back when the folder closes.

items.name: fuse-button
items.title: Fuse Button
items.description: Action button whose done state carries its own undo on a burning fuse: press, the label crossfades to Undo, a hairline burns for the undo window, and Undo or Escape runs it back.

items.name: glide-select
items.title: Glide Select
items.description: Select chip whose menu pops out of its own corner and whose single hover highlight glides between rows, remembering where you left it so re-entry slides from there instead of blinking in.

items.name: hold-button
items.title: Hold Button
items.description: Hold-to-confirm button whose liquid fill rises while pressed, snaps back on an early release and swaps its label through a blur when the hold completes.

items.name: jelly-radio
items.title: Jelly Radio
items.description: Radio group of labelled chips where the chosen one swells wide-then-tall on two springs and barges its neighbours outward with a travelling stagger, so a selection reads as a force moving through the row.

items.name: lattice-loader
items.title: Lattice Loader
items.description: Inline agent-status row: a 3x3 or 4x4 lattice whose cells brighten in a phase-offset wave beside a verb and a live stopwatch, resolving into a check or a cross when the task ends.

items.name: paper-crumple
items.title: Paper Crumple
items.description: An image that crumples into a textured 3D sheet while held and follows the grabbed point as you drag. Release it as a crumpled ball, unfold it flat, or leave the paper creased, with customizable folds, paper grain, lighting and shadows.

items.name: peek-rating
items.title: Peek Rating
items.description: Star rating you can try before you commit: sweeping the row lifts a trailing wave of stars up to the pointer while a tip hops along with the label; a click commits with a pop.

items.name: prompt-bar
items.title: Prompt Bar
items.description: Chat composer with an @ sources menu, a / commands menu, a model picker, dictation and attachments, whose send tile charges to ink the moment there is something to send and morphs its arrow into a stop square while busy.

items.name: pulse-heart
items.title: Pulse Heart
items.description: Like button that contracts to a dot, flips colour at its smallest frame and pulses back while the count swaps one glyph.

items.name: refine-frame
items.title: Refine Frame
items.description: Reserved-aspect frame that walks any media through queued, generating, refining and complete without layout shift: each stage is one blur, saturate, scale and opacity tween, a soft band sweeps while it works, a chip reports the stage, and an error dims the picture behind a retry pill.

items.name: rubber-segment
items.title: Rubber Segment
items.description: Segmented control with a rubber thumb: taps stretch it across the gap and squash it onto the target, and you can grab, drag and flick it between slots.

items.name: scrub-field
items.title: Scrub Field
items.description: Number chip you drag to scrub: the value follows the hand, pushes past the range on a rubber band, and a click without moving opens it for typing.

items.name: slide-commit
items.title: Slide Commit
items.description: Slide-to-confirm handle that plants with a spinner while your action runs, unfurls into a done pill on success and springs home with a squash and shake on failure.

items.name: sling-button
items.title: Sling Button
items.description: Send button you pull back like a slingshot: the band stretches, a power arc arms it, and releasing fires the action with the flick's velocity.

items.name: slosh-gauge
items.title: Slosh Gauge
items.description: Tank gauge whose liquid chases the value with mass, tilts with its own speed and splashes against the top when it slams full; optionally a vertical slider.

items.name: spring-check
items.title: Spring Check
items.description: Checkbox row where a single spring fills the box, draws the tick, strikes the label and dims the words in one press.

items.name: squish-switch
items.title: Squish Switch
items.description: Drag-scrubbable switch whose thumb stretches by how fast it moves, flips at the midpoint and squashes against the track end on a flick.

items.name: status-mark
items.title: Status Mark
items.description: A 20px status glyph for agent task lists that morphs in place from a dashed idle ring to a spinning or real-progress arc, then draws a check or a cross, with an optional label strike.

items.name: swipe-row
items.title: Swipe Row
items.description: List row that swipes open to reveal actions, snaps by flick velocity, and deletes on a full swipe that stretches the action colour across the row.

items.name: swipe-toast
items.title: Swipe Toast
items.description: Single toast that rises through its bottom edge, swipes down to dismiss on a flick or a distance, and burns a thin fuse for exactly its remaining time; hover pauses it and an inline mode keeps it inside any container.

items.name: tear-ticket
items.title: Tear Ticket
items.description: Ticket whose perforated stub tears off by hand: paper bridges stretch into fibres and snap one by one from the far end, the torn edges are jagged and fit each other, the freed stub dangles and drops, and the body is stamped as used. The artwork tilts in 3D with parallax on hover.

items.name: thought-line
items.title: Thought Line
items.description: Reasoning-trace header: a glyph and a label breathe beside a live clock while steps appear beneath, then the line settles on one beat into "Thought for 4.2s" through a blur crossfade and the trace folds into it.

items.name: voice-pill
items.title: Voice Pill
items.description: Mic button that swells into a tinted capsule of level-driven equalizer bars and an elapsed clock while held or toggled, then relaxes back into the mic on release; simulated voice by default, real microphone as an opt-in.

items.name: wake-slider
items.title: Wake Slider
items.description: Range slider drawn as thin bars with no thumb: drag speed raises a wake that trails behind the handle and flattens again at rest.

items.name: warm-tooltip
items.title: Warm Tooltip
items.description: Tooltip group with one shared delay: the first label waits and pops from its trigger, then siblings open instantly while the group is warm, with an optional velocity lean.

items.name: ascii-text
items.title: ASCII Text
items.description: Renders text with an animated ASCII background for a retro feel.

items.name: blur-text
items.title: Blur Text
items.description: Per-word/letter blur-in animation triggered when scrolled into view, with configurable direction, easing and stepped keyframes.

items.name: circular-text
items.title: Circular Text
items.description: Layouts characters around a circle with optional rotation animation.

items.name: count-up
items.title: Count Up
items.description: Spring-animated number counter that counts up (or down) when scrolled into view, with configurable spring physics, delay, and number formatting.

items.name: curved-loop

items.description: Marquee text rendered along a curved SVG path that scrolls infinitely and can be dragged for interactive control.

items.name: decrypted-text

items.name: falling-text

items.name: fuzzy-text

items.name: glitch-text

items.name: gradient-text

items.name: scrambled-text

items.name: scroll-float
items.title: Scroll Float

items.name: scroll-reveal

items.name: scroll-velocity

items.name: shiny-text
items.title: Shiny Text

items.name: shuffle

items.name: split-text

items.name: text-type

items.name: true-focus

items.name: variable-proximity
